item.title: Constantine by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspiration: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 0.00 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Refined, sun-warmed, and confidently fresh, Constantine by Mykonos is an aromatic spicy fragrance built around cardamom, violet leaf, pineapple, and a clean amberwood-musk base. It opens with the warmth of cardamom and the crisp green snap of violet leaf, brightened by pineapple and mandarin orange.

At its heart, lily of the valley, jasmine, lavender, and artemisia create a clean, polished aromatic character, while a base of amberwood, moss, and white musk keeps the finish smooth and refined. Marketed by Mykonos as "The Summer King," Constantine is an original composition built for warm-weather confidence — a full 50ml bottle in this fresh, powerful style.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cardamom, Violet Leaf, Pineapple, Mandarin Orange
Middle: Lily of the Valley, Jasmine, Lavender, Artemisia
Base: Amberwood, Moss, White Musk

Scent Profile

Constantine sits in the aromatic / fresh spicy / woody musk lane — fresh without feeling casual, and powerful without becoming loud.

Expect a fragrance that feels polished, composed, and effortlessly confident — a clean aromatic scent built for warm days and long nights.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer
Occasion: Everyday wear, nights out, warm-weather events
Style: Fresh, refined, confident, aromatic

Try Before You Commit

Constantine opens with a spiced cardamom and green violet leaf burst brightened by pineapple. As it develops, lily of the valley, jasmine, and lavender bring a clean floral-aromatic character, before amberwood and white musk settle in for a smooth, refined finish.

Try Constantine by Mykonos with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

The dry-down brings a gourmand accord together with amberwood, solar notes, amber, and cashmeran for a warm, glowing finish. Luminos is an original Mykonos composition — a full 50ml bottle built around a radiant, "glow beyond the ordinary" concept.

Overview

Fresh, fruity, and effortlessly modern, Banadir 40 by Banadir Fragrance is a clean woody-musky fragrance that blends juicy pear, sparkling citrus, aromatic ginger, soft orange blossom, and smooth musky woods.

It opens with pear, bergamot, ginger, and mandarin, creating a crisp and energetic introduction. Pear adds a juicy sweetness while bergamot and mandarin bring brightness, and ginger gives the opening a subtle fresh-spicy kick.

As it develops, orange blossom and Georgywood™ become more noticeable. Orange blossom adds a clean floral softness while the woody accord gives the fragrance structure and keeps the fruity opening polished and sophisticated.

The dry-down combines Ambrofix™, Akigalawood™, and musk, creating a smooth, airy woody foundation with a clean musky character that stays fresh and modern on the skin. These are the official notes Ex Nihilo lists for Blue Talisman.

Inspired by Blue Talisman by Ex Nihilo, Banadir 40 delivers a similar balance of juicy fruit, sparkling citrus, airy florals, clean musk, and contemporary woody depth.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Bergamot, Ginger, Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom, Georgywood™
Base: Ambrofix™, Akigalawood™, Musk

Scent Profile

Banadir 40 sits in the fruity / citrus / woody / musky / fresh spicy / aromatic category.

Expect a fragrance that feels:

  • Fresh and clean
  • Juicy and fruity
  • Bright and citrusy
  • Lightly spicy
  • Smooth and musky
  • Modern and sophisticated

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, early fall, and year-round daytime wear
Occasion: Everyday wear, office, vacations, dates, casual outings, dinners
Style: Fresh, modern, polished, versatile
Category: Fruity woody-musky signature scent

Try Before You Commit

Banadir 40 begins with juicy pear surrounded by sparkling bergamot and mandarin, while ginger adds a crisp spicy freshness that makes the opening feel bright and energetic.

As it settles, orange blossom introduces a clean floral softness while Georgywood™ adds a smooth woody character. Ambrofix™, Akigalawood™, and musk then take over in the dry-down, leaving a clean, airy, and softly woody trail with a polished modern finish.

Refined, woody, and confidently sophisticated, Banadir 100 by Banadir Fragrance is a fresh woody-oud fragrance that blends sparkling citrus, aromatic spice, smooth woods, smoky incense, and warm resinous depth.

It opens with grapefruit and cardamom, creating a bright citrus introduction with a warm aromatic spice. The opening feels crisp and polished rather than heavy, giving the fragrance an elegant freshness from the first spray.

As it develops, angelica and geranium bring an aromatic, slightly green character that transitions smoothly into the deeper woody elements of the fragrance.

The dry-down combines oud, incense, benzoin, and cedarwood, creating a rich woody foundation with smoky warmth and a subtle resinous sweetness. The result is sophisticated and luxurious without becoming overly dark or overpowering.

Inspired by Royal Oud by Creed, Banadir 100 delivers a similar contrast between bright freshness, aromatic spice, refined woods, and smoky oud depth.

item.title: Banadir 102 by Banadir Fragrance – Sample Decant

Overview

Rich, creamy, and deeply luxurious, Banadir 102 by Banadir Fragrance is a warm vanilla-amber fragrance built around intense vanilla, aromatic spices, resinous amber, and soft musk.

It opens with warm spices, giving the fragrance an inviting touch of heat that immediately complements its sweet vanilla character. Rather than smelling like a simple sugary vanilla, the opening feels rich, polished, and sophisticated.

As it develops, vanilla becomes the centerpiece—smooth, creamy, and enveloping with a slightly powdery gourmand quality. The sweetness feels full-bodied without losing the elegant character of the fragrance.

The dry-down brings forward amber, opoponax, and musk, creating a warm resinous foundation that adds depth to the vanilla and leaves a smooth, sensual trail on the skin.

Inspired by Vanille Planifolia Extrait 21 by Guerlain, Banadir 102 follows its signature combination of concentrated vanilla, spices, amber-like resins, and musk. Guerlain describes the original as an intensely concentrated vanilla accented with spices and wrapped in musk and its opopanine amber accord.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Warm Spices
Middle: Vanilla
Base: Amber, Opoponax, Musk

The original fragrance is officially centered around vanilla, spices, amber/opoponax and musk rather than a strict traditional note pyramid.

Scent Profile

Banadir 102 sits in the vanilla / amber / gourmand / warm spicy / musky category.

Expect a fragrance that feels:

  • Rich and vanilla-forward
  • Warm and creamy
  • Sweet and gourmand
  • Smoothly spiced
  • Resinous and ambery
  • Luxurious and sensual

Best For

Season: Fall, winter, and cool spring evenings
Occasion: Date nights, dinners, special occasions, evenings out
Style: Warm, luxurious, elegant, sensual
Category: Vanilla amber-gourmand signature scent

Try Before You Commit

Banadir 102 begins with warm aromatic spices surrounding a rich vanilla sweetness, creating a cozy and luxurious first impression.

As it settles, vanilla becomes smoother and creamier, giving the fragrance its decadent gourmand character. Amber and opoponax then bring a deeper resinous warmth while musk softens the dry-down, leaving a sweet, smooth, and sophisticated vanilla trail.

item.description:

Overview

Rich, warm, and unapologetically luxurious, Banadir 97 by Banadir Fragrance is an amber-gourmand fragrance built around spicy citrus, smoky tobacco, dried fruits, creamy vanilla, and deep resinous woods.

It opens with a lively combination of rum, bitter orange, cardamom, pink pepper, ginger, bergamot, and grapefruit, creating a warm, boozy citrus introduction with an elegant spicy edge.

As it develops, dried fruits, blonde tobacco, saffron, sandalwood, tuberose, osmanthus, jasmine, and orris create a rich and sophisticated heart. The dried fruits add sweetness while tobacco and saffron bring warmth and depth, balanced by creamy woods and smooth florals.

The dry-down becomes deeper and more indulgent with tonka bean, vanilla, myrrh, labdanum, patchouli, musk, cedar, and vetiver, leaving behind a warm, creamy amber trail with smoky, woody, and slightly gourmand character.

Inspired by Blonde Amber by Clive Christian, Banadir 97 captures the luxurious combination of warm amber, sweet tobacco, dried fruits, spices, vanilla, and tonka that defines the original scent profile. Clive Christian highlights bitter orange, blonde tobacco, and tonka as three of Blonde Amber's key notes.

Middle: Dried Fruits, Blonde Tobacco, Sandalwood, Saffron, Tuberose, Osmanthus, Jasmine, Orris
Base: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Myrrh, Labdanum, Patchouli, Musk, Cedar, Vetiver

Tonka bean and vanilla then become more noticeable in the dry-down alongside amber-like resins, woods, and musk, creating a deep, creamy, and indulgent finish.
